title: This is THE recipe you need to make classic cookie icing that sets fi...
description: This is THE recipe you need to make classic cookie icing that sets firm (🤌🏻) and isn’t too sweet. #sugarcookies #sugarcookieicing #icingcookies #christmascookies #cookiedecorating #frostingrecipe
transcript: You know those iconic sugar cookies you see in the bakery aisle? The ones with the frosting that's not too sweet but sets perfectly? This is that recipe. I'm going to start by sifting powdered sugar. And then the next two ingredients are what really make this the best cookie icing ever. Melted butter and whole milk. Now the melted butter in this recipe is what allows this icing to set firm, which is what we all want in a classic sugar cookie topping. It's also so silky smooth because I've sifted that powdered sugar. If you can diet any color of the rainbow, I like to use gel-based food coloring because you only need one or two drops to get a really vibrant color. It's important to work quickly when you're making this icing because it will set within about five minutes. So after I've spread it on top of the cookies, I like to add my sprinkles or any other toppings and then let the cookies set until the icing is completely firm. Add the recipe on just a taste.
